info.comments: Wails v2.12.0. Frontend lives OUTSIDE the Wails project root per the topic-sliced layout (condura-mind/CLAUDE.md.legacy §29.5.4). The ../../../cd path is intentional: ../ from cmd/condura-gui/ → condura-app/; ../ from condura-app/ → synaptic/; ../ from synaptic/ → ./ ; then cd into condura-gui/frontend. Verify with `realpath ../..` from the Wails project root if this path becomes stale after a future reorg.
